definition: something your mind wrongly takes as real
description: A sunny old-town street. On a yellow plastered wall a door and a garden view are painted so realistically that they look like a real open archway. A young woman in a denim jacket, lilac top and white pleated skirt presses her hand flat against the painted door and stares at it with her mouth wide open, surprised that it is only a flat wall. Friends at a small cafe table laugh at her, one covering her mouth, and a waiter stands behind. A pink blossom tree, green shutters, red flowers and petals on the cobbles fill the scene.
